title: cayratia japonica var. pseudotrifolia
intro: Cayratia japonica var. pseudotrifolia, commonly known as Japanese grape, is a type of flowering plant in the Vitaceae family. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cayratia japonica var. pseudotrifolia include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce cholesterol levels, and exhibit antimicrobial and antidiabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
